newsitem.title: USA: Washington National declines comment on sale.
newsitem.headline: Washington National declines comment on sale.

text.p: Washington National Corp declined comment on Thursday on a report that it was exploring a possible sale of the company.

The statement followed a report that appeared on Reuters on Wednesday. The report, citing people familiar with the situation, said the company had hired Morgan Stanley as its investment banker and had opened its books to prospective buyers.
Washington National shares rose 1-1/2, or about five percent, to 29-7/8 at midday after a delayed opening.
Sources said several parties had expressed interest in the Lincolnshire, Ill.-based life insurer, but they declined to identify them.
However, industry sources said possible suitors could include Conseco Inc, Jefferson-Pilot Corp, Equitable Cos Inc as well as some moderate-sized insurers such as ReliaStar Financial Corp.

Conseco, Jefferson-Pilot, Equitable all declined comment. ReliaStar said Wednesday it was always in the process of evaluating potential acquisition candidates, but said it had no comment on Washington National in particular.
Conseco fell 1-1/8 to 44-1/4, Jefferson-Pilot was unchanged at 51-3/4, Equitable was up 1/8 to 25-5/8 and ReliaStar was down 1/2 to 45-7/8.
